description: This PHP script handles the server-side logic for mail merge operations within a SuiteCRM environment. It processes user input to select records, retrieves document templates, sets up a MailMerge object, executes the merging process, and redirects to a confirmation page.

classes.name: MailMerge
classes.description: A class responsible for performing the mail merge operation, including setting data, field list, template, execution, and cleanup.

methods.name: SetDataList
methods.description: Sets the list of data items to be merged into the template.

methods.name: SetFieldList
methods.description: Specifies the list of fields to be included in the merge.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Sets the template document(s) for the merge process.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the mail merge process and returns the filename of the resulting document.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations after the merge execution.
